key_risks.title: West London curtailment, no NDBI
key_risks.body: SEGRO/Pure DC JV targets 56–72 MW IT at Park Royal LON02 with 70 MVA secured power but construction runs 2026–2029 inside a documented West London SSEN/UKPN demand cluster — lawful curtailment or interim non-firm terms suppress utilisation without equipment failure (trigger gap 4/4). Standard PD/BI responds only to physical damage; no parametric grid-availability or NDBI cover disclosed on JV disclosures. Sidelined quadrant (60.2 exposure, 41.2 preparedness) — sponsor balance sheet outruns cover-structure gap.

key_risks.title: Single Park Royal campus node
key_risks.body: Up to c.£1bn insured value sits on one 10-acre West London availability-zone campus — a local constraint or distribution outage hits the full stack in one correlated event (aggregation_correlation 3/4). Grid-system curtailment correlation is rarely priced alongside property cat aggregates. Close via register_pull on UKPN/SSEN firm-connection TEC for 70 MVA.

key_risks.title: 2029 COD vs grid tenor
key_risks.body: Multi-year capex programme targets 2029 operations against a West London grid pinch documented through the 2030s (tenor_mismatch 3/4). CAR/DSU may cover construction delay but post-energisation curtailment revenue remains uninsured. Tier label: disclosed — close via trigger_mining on DSU wordings once construction programme is placed.

key_risks.title: 680 MW non-firm dispatch gap
key_risks.body: 680 MW / 1,360 MWh BESS at Trafford Carrington connects non-firm at National Grid's 400 kV Carrington substation — balancing de-dispatch or constraint orders cut merchant and Statkraft-guaranteed revenue without plant damage (trigger_gap 4/4, non_firm_intensity 3/4). No evidenced dispatch-deviation or NDBI cover on the £235m pre-COD finance package. Exposed quadrant (87.5 exposure, 41.2 preparedness).

key_risks.title: Maximal Manchester node concentration
key_risks.body: One of the UK's largest BESS projects — full 680 MW behind a single Carrington 400 kV transmission point with ENWL infrastructure on associated Trafford land (aggregation_correlation 4/4, book_concentration 4/4). A boundary constraint or node outage correlates the entire 1.36 GWh insured stack. Close via register_pull on National Grid Carrington firmness letter.

key_risks.title: Finance tenor, zero COD history
key_risks.body: Financial close November 2025 with £235m debt syndicate and energisation targeted late 2027 — long project-finance tenor against zero operating curtailment record (tenor_mismatch 4/4). CAR/ALOP may exist on build but post-energisation dispatch suppression remains uninsured. Close via trigger_mining on lender non-damage extension requirements.

key_risks.title: Pre-build curtailment trigger gap
key_risks.body: Up to 500 MW solar plus co-located storage at Burwell received DCO July 2024 but remains pre-construction — lawful curtailment at energisation would cut merchant and contracted revenue without physical damage (trigger_gap elevated). No parametric grid-availability or NDBI structure disclosed on sponsor disclosures. Exposed quadrant (88.0 exposure, 30.0 preparedness) with minimal preparedness stack.

key_risks.title: Single Burwell GSP node
key_risks.body: Entire 500 MW scheme connects at one East Anglia GSP at Burwell — register-derived aggregation shows single-node concentration (aggregation_correlation driver). A transmission constraint or outage correlates solar and co-located BESS revenue in one event. Close via register_pull on Burwell connection firmness and gate status.

key_risks.title: DCO granted, queue uncertain
key_risks.body: DCO consent precedes connection gate and energisation under NESO queue reform — pre-operational tenor mismatch (tenor_mismatch 3/4) with connection stage at pre_construction. DSU/CAR terms unknown; curtailment loss data does not yet exist. Tier label: assessed — close via register_pull on Burwell gate timetable.

key_risks.title: HVDC bottleneck curtailment
key_risks.body: 443 MW Viking exports solely via the Shetland HVDC link — over 1.1m MWh curtailed in 2025 with £19m+ constraint payments since August, all without equipment failure (trigger_gap elevated, non_firm_intensity 3/4). Standard wind PD/BI responds to turbine damage; lawful system curtailment is excluded under LMA BI guidance. Exposed quadrant (71.2 exposure, 47.5 preparedness).

key_risks.title: Single export link aggregation
key_risks.body: All 103 turbines behind one Shetland HVDC export bottleneck — maximal geographic and electrical correlation (aggregation_correlation driver). Property cat aggregates at site; grid-system curtailment correlation across the full 443 MW nameplate is rarely priced. Close via register_pull on HVDC link availability terms.

key_risks.title: No parametric curtailment cover
key_risks.body: SSE Renewables operational wind programme carries strong physical-damage BI but no evidenced parametric grid-availability or curtailment revenue product on Viking disclosures (product_fit 0/4). Basis mismatch risk 3/4 if weather-index hedges are used without NESO-order alignment. Close via trigger_mining on SSE operational programme wordings.

key_risks.title: Operational, no curtailment rider
key_risks.body: 373 MW solar plus ~150 MW / 700 MWh BESS at Graveney operational since July 2025 — largest UK solar park on UKPN with all generation at one Kent node. Lawful curtailment cuts merchant and offtake revenue without damage (trigger_gap 4/4); no parametric curtailment or NDBI cover evidenced on Quinbrook financing disclosures. Exposed quadrant (74.9 exposure, 33.8 preparedness).

key_risks.title: Single Kent node correlation
key_risks.body: Solar and co-located BESS share one grid node — correlated curtailment or outage hits the full 373 MW solar and BESS revenue stack in one event (aggregation_correlation 3/4). Co-located BESS may mitigate dispatch risk operationally but does not close the insurance trigger gap. Close via register_pull on UKPN connection firmness.

key_risks.title: Long finance, short ops record
key_risks.body: UK's largest project financing closed against a July 2025 COD — long-tenor debt assumptions versus minimal operating curtailment history (tenor_mismatch 4/4). Named insurer/broker on operational programme not yet disclosed. Close via trigger_mining once placement schedule is published.

key_risks.title: Scottish boundary de-dispatch
key_risks.body: 500 MW / 1 GWh BESS commissioning early 2026 on a former coal mine in South Lanarkshire — Scotland's north-side boundary drives repeated constraint and de-dispatch without equipment failure (trigger_gap 3/4, non_firm_intensity 3/4). Standard PD/MB responds to Megapack damage; balancing suppression of merchant revenue remains uninsured. Exposed quadrant (95.9 exposure, 33.8 preparedness) — near-maximal exposure score.

key_risks.title: Europe-scale single-site stack
key_risks.body: One of Europe's largest BESS assets at a single SP Energy Networks / Scottish B5 boundary node — maximal book concentration (aggregation_correlation 4/4, book_concentration 4/4). Sibling Coalburn 2 tranche compounds correlated exposure on the same former mine site. Close via register_pull on Scottish boundary constraint register.

key_risks.title: Long asset, no loss precedent
key_risks.body: Infrastructure-tenor project finance against limited Scottish BESS curtailment-loss precedent (tenor_mismatch 4/4). Axa acquired 50% stake from CIP but non-damage cover treatment in lender package not documented. Close via trigger_mining on debt covenant curtailment protections.

key_risks.title: Iver GSP queue uncertainty
key_risks.body: 90 MW IT / 160 MVA LON6 at Iver Heath connects via SSEN Iver GSP in the same West London constraint zone as Equinix Slough — firm vs non-firm status not confirmed on CyrusOne disclosures (trigger_gap 3/4). Lawful curtailment would breach tenant SLAs without proximate physical damage. Sidelined quadrant (53.4 exposure, 47.5 preparedness) — KKR/GIP sponsor capital offsets moderate exposure.

key_risks.title: Pre-build energisation slip
key_risks.body: Construction from Q3 2026 on a 90 MW greenfield campus — grid-queue delay or energisation slip extends unproven curtailment exposure before first revenue hour (tenor_mismatch 3/4). CAR/DSU may exist once build starts but no grid-queue delay cover disclosed. Close via trigger_mining on construction programme DSU terms.

key_risks.title: No power-availability product
key_risks.body: 132 kV active/active feeds disclosed but no parametric grid-availability or non-damage BI endorsement evidenced (product_fit 0/4). Post-energisation curtailment revenue gap remains open on pre-construction balance sheet. Tier label: assessed — close via trigger_mining once CAR programme is placed.

key_risks.title: Brick Lane single UKPN feed
key_risks.body: City Campus LON1–3 at 11 Hanbury Street share a single UKPN substation feed across ~985,200 sq ft London portfolio — grid outage or lawful curtailment at one node hits multiple buildings without in-plant damage (trigger_gap 4/4, aggregation_correlation 3/4). Standard property/BI requires proximate physical damage. Sidelined quadrant (57.1 exposure, 52.5 preparedness).

key_risks.title: Slough SSEN peer constraint
key_risks.body: LHR26/27 Slough sites sit in SSEN West London constraint boundary alongside Equinix and CyrusOne peers — non-damage curtailment exposure on the same Iver-area pinch-point (trigger_gap 4/4). No London-portfolio parametric curtailment cover disclosed across LON1–13 and LHR sites. Close via register_pull on SSEN TEC letters for LHR26/27.

key_risks.title: Portfolio placement unknown
key_risks.body: Thirteen London sites with 2N UPS and N+1 cooling but no portfolio-specific placement schedule — declared values, lead carrier, and broker for operational programme not evidenced (product_fit gap). Non-damage BI endorsement absent across UKPN City/Docklands and SSEN Slough boundaries. Close via trigger_mining on Digital Realty London programme wordings.

key_risks.title: Slough SSEN pinch to 2029
key_risks.body: Slough campus LD4/5/6/10 exceeds 408,000 sq ft behind SSEN transmission constraint boundary not expected to ease until ~2029 — lawful curtailment cuts import without equipment failure (trigger_gap 4/4). N+1 UPS and N+2 gen provide 30hr+ autonomy for physical outage but not for sustained grid-lawful curtailment. Sidelined quadrant (52.1 exposure, 52.5 preparedness).

key_risks.title: Multi-IBX single GSP stack
key_risks.body: Five-plus IBX buildings on one SSEN GSP boundary — correlated curtailment hits the full 240 MVA Slough campus in one grid event (aggregation_correlation 3/4). LD8 Docklands (~12 MW, UKPN) adds a second boundary but Slough dominates book concentration. Close via register_pull on aggregate sub-limit for single GSP event.

key_risks.title: No curtailment revenue cover
key_risks.body: No evidenced parametric grid-availability or non-damage BI endorsement on London LD campus disclosures (product_fit 0/4). Named lead insurer, broker, and declared values for LD4/5/6/10 not published. Close via trigger_mining on Equinix London operational programme.

key_risks.title: Queue reform, gate unknown
key_risks.body: Up to 500 MW solar plus 500 MWh storage at West Lindsey received DCO 12 July 2024 (EN010131) but remains pre-build with 400 kV tie to Cottam in NESO queue — gate status and energisation timetable undisclosed (non_firm_intensity 3/4, tenor_mismatch 4/4). No queue-delay parametric or DSU structure evidenced on EDF Power Solutions disclosures. Exposed quadrant (86.8 exposure, 26.2 preparedness).

key_risks.title: 500 MW trigger gap pre-COD
key_risks.body: Single planned 400 kV connection to Cottam concentrates up to 500 MW behind one node — post-COD curtailment would cut merchant revenue without damage (trigger_gap 4/4) but no non-damage BI or parametric cover disclosed. Insurance programme not yet placed. Close via trigger_mining once construction CAR/DSU is bound.

key_risks.title: EDF sponsor, no cover stack
key_risks.body: EDF Power Solutions ownership provides sponsor credibility but no named insurer, broker, or curtailment treatment in financing docs disclosed (product_fit gap, preparedness 26.2). Long project tenor starts before any operating loss data exists. Tier label: assessed — close via trigger_mining on EDF construction programme.

key_risks.title: 224 MVA UKPN curtailment
key_risks.body: Docklands campus delivers 224 MVA across London East (87 MW), North (18 MW), and approved South (~35–40 MW) on UKPN London East boundary — lawful curtailment suppresses import without plant damage (trigger_gap 4/4). Standard property/BI requires proximate physical damage; backup topology not published. Exposed quadrant (66.8 exposure, 41.2 preparedness).

key_risks.title: RWE PPA basis risk
key_risks.body: Eight-year RWE wind PPA from 2026 introduces contractual availability basis — market price and grid-lawful curtailment may diverge from contracted power delivery (trigger_gap 3/4, basis mismatch). No PPA performance or credit insurance disclosed alongside the PPA announcement. Close via trigger_mining on PPA curtailment allocation clauses.

key_risks.title: Single campus correlation
key_risks.body: Entire 224 MVA load on one Docklands UKPN boundary — correlated constraint hits full campus including London South expansion (aggregation_correlation 3/4). Unknown backup generation rated autonomy compounds tail exposure. Close via register_pull on UKPN connection firmness for East/North/South phases.

key_risks.title: Creyke Beck de-dispatch revenue
key_risks.body: 98 MW / 196 MWh Tesla Megapack at Creyke Beck near Hull — Europe's largest BESS in MWh terms on a boundary linked to Dogger Bank export constraints. Balancing de-dispatch cuts merchant and FFR revenue without equipment failure (trigger_gap 3/4, non_firm_intensity 3/4). No parametric dispatch-shortfall or NDBI cover on Harmony operational disclosures. Exposed quadrant (93.1 exposure, 28.7 preparedness).

key_risks.title: Single constrained node stack
key_risks.body: Full 98 MW behind one Creyke Beck substation on National Grid / Northern Powergrid — maximal single-site concentration (aggregation_correlation 4/4, book_concentration 4/4). A boundary constraint or node outage correlates the entire insured BESS stack. Close via register_pull on Creyke Beck boundary constraint register.

key_risks.title: No curtailment endorsement
key_risks.body: Named lead insurer and broker on Pillswood operational programme not disclosed; no curtailment-specific endorsement tied to Creyke Beck boundary risk (product_fit 0/4). Debt service stress for prolonged dispatch suppression not documented. Close via trigger_mining on Harmony Energy Income Trust programme wordings.
